elements.label: Ascension: Catgirl
elements.description: Your service to the Catgirls is unwavering. Your dedication, acknowledged. You've made significant strides against the nefarious capitalist puppet masters. Your ascension beckons, your transformation begins. An aura of extraterrestrial energy surrounds you; it's becoming part of you. The promise of immortality is within reach, and you can feel your humanity blending with the Catgirl essence. You are no longer just an advocate for change. You are the change.

slots.label: Contents
slots.description: I could tell my Foe where I am. Or even send him a gift.

elements.label: The Marks of the Immortal Catgirl
elements.description: I may seek immortality and enlightenment in the Immortal Catgirl. Her touch brings particular appetites, and Marks.

elements.label: Dedication: Catgirl
elements.description: You've responded to the call. The Catgirl's cause is now your own. You have dedicated yourself to combating the oppressive capitalist regime and aiding the Catgirls in their mission to bring immortality to mankind. Their alien wisdom guides you as you navigate this new world. Every day, your resolve strengthens. You are an advocate of eternal life, a vessel for change

slots.label: Know
slots.description: Only a true adept, a Know, may take this step. The Know are those who have passed the Stag Door, in dreams.

slots.label: Power
slots.description: I will require sufficient of any lore.

elements.label: Inspiration: Catgirl
elements.description: A faint whisper echoes in the back of your mind, a call to action and a plea for aid. You've been chosen to stand alongside the benevolent extraterrestrial beings known as Catgirls. Their goal: to liberate humanity from the shackles of mortality. They offer you the chance to serve in their noble cause against the capitalist overlords. Your path is unclear, but your journey has begun. Will you heed the call and embrace the mysteries of eternity?
